Specification: This module is a test suite for TLA+ set operators, specifically focusing on union (\cup), intersection (\cap), subset (\subseteq), and set difference (\). It defines a single variable x and checks a series of set-theoretic identities and membership properties using IF-THEN-ELSE constructs within the Inv operator. The tests cover combinations of set enumeration, set comprehension, tuples, sequences, and function types, as well as the use of the BOOLEAN set and integer/ natural number sets. The module is intended to verify the correct behavior of set operations and their interaction with other TLA+ constructs, using assertions and print statements to indicate pass/fail for each test.
IfThenElse: IF -5 \\notin Int \\cup Nat THEN ... ELSE ... (in Inv)
IF -5 \\notin Nat \\cup Int THEN ... ELSE ... (in Inv)

IF {1, 2, 3, 4} \\ {i \\in Int : i > 2} # {2, 1} THEN ... ELSE ... (in Inv)
IF <<1, 2>> \\notin Seq({1,2,3}) \\cap  Seq({0,1,2}) THEN ... ELSE ... (in Inv)
IF <<1, 2>> \\notin Seq({0,1}) \\cup  Seq({1,2,3}) THEN ... ELSE ... (in Inv)
IF {1,2,3} \\subseteq {i \\in Int : i < 3} THEN ... ELSE ... (in Inv)
